name: Middle Charrette Creek
places: New Melle Fire Protection District Station 3
about: Middle Charrette Creek drains about 43 square miles, 3% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 880 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 480 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Tuque Creek, Charrette Creek, Wolf Creek and College Creek. Downstream, its water passes through the Lower Charrette Creek watershed on its way down the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
